list_child.name: lstImg
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete list of imaging orders currently held by the radiology center, spanning every referring provider and every study status.

get_child.name: getImg
get_child.desc: Look up a single imaging order using its unique identifier and return the full set of details currently recorded for that study.

list_parent.name: lstRef
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the complete list of referring providers currently on file with the radiology center, regardless of how many studies they have ordered.

get_parent.name: getRef
get_parent.desc: Look up a single referring provider using their unique identifier and return their complete current details.

delete_child.name: delImg
delete_child.desc: Permanently remove an imaging order from the system; once this action is confirmed the record cannot be recovered.

set_enum.name: setImgStatus
set_enum.desc: Update the status of an imaging order, moving it through the workflow from ordered, to scheduled, to completed, and finally to read and finalized.

set_bool.name: flagCritical
set_bool.desc: Mark an imaging order as containing a critical finding so that it is escalated to the reading radiologist and referring provider without delay.

set_ref.name: moveRef
set_ref.desc: Reassign an imaging order so that it is associated with a different referring provider than the one currently on file.

send.name: notifyRef
send.desc: Send a notification to a referring provider regarding one of their imaging orders, using the center's standard results-delivery channel.
child_verbs: give the referring provider on {obj} a heads-up
